verdict.rationale: WorkOS publishes an API reference section (/docs/reference/... pages such as CLI Auth and MFA) and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, which could be loaded into third-party API explorers. Nothing in the pack shows that the reference itself is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable or executable request examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
